create.name: Nid Ra
create.bio:
Nid Ra teaches yoga nidra, breathwork, movement and energy practice from Manly on Sydney's northern beaches, and works with students online around the world under the name Nid's Nidra. She has been guiding people in these practices for over 25 years. Her path into the work began when a brain injury brought her career as a media lawyer to a halt, and her long recovery became a slow rebuilding, with each practice she found adding something new.

Some years later, during a spell of deep confusion, she began drawing sacred geometry, and from those drawings came the Awakening Spiral, the map that now shapes all her teaching. It describes six layers of experience, from being present in the body to letting your own light show, and draws on five kinds of practice: meditation and energy work, breath and sound, movement, contemplation, and rest. She teaches it through a monthly cycle of live online classes, a membership library, a short meditation course and one-to-one work, including Soul Realignment, an Akashic Records method. She also hosts the Nid's Nidra podcast and shares many free practices on YouTube and Insight Timer.

courses.title: Living the Awakening Spiral Weekly
courses.description: Live group classes on Zoom in the first four weeks of each month, each month built around one theme seen through the six layers of the Awakening Spiral. Sessions run 60 to 75 minutes and mix breath, movement, meditation and reflection. A four-class pack covers one monthly cycle.

courses.title: Your Sanctuary Membership
courses.description: A membership that includes the weekly live classes plus replays, a practice library for every layer, her seven-part meditation course and several shorter self-paced courses. It starts with a seven-day free trial and can be paid monthly or yearly.
courses.price: A$95 AUD a month or A$888 AUD a year

courses.title: The Awakening Spiral Meditation Course
courses.description: Seven short guided meditations, one for each layer of the Awakening Spiral and a last one that brings them together. Work through them at your own pace.

courses.title: Soul Shift
courses.description: A three-month one-to-one programme of six online sessions every fortnight, each focused on a single layer of the Spiral, taken in whatever order suits where you are. It includes practices between sessions and WhatsApp contact, and opens with a free connection call.

courses.title: Soul Realignment
courses.description: A private Akashic Records reading in which Nid looks at your soul blueprint and the recurring patterns she finds there, then talks you through them and gives simple practices to take into daily life. Two sessions over four weeks, by application.

courses.title: The Awakening Spiral on Insight Timer
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course in which Nid introduces the Awakening Spiral one layer at a time, with a short guided practice each day.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Nid Ra on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Nid's guided yoga nidra sessions, from short rests to a full night-long practice, along with energy and light meditations. Free to listen in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Rest in Awareness
free_resources.description: A self-paced course on carrying the restful awareness of yoga nidra into ordinary days, with lessons under fifteen minutes and very short practices for daily life. It gives access to her full yoga nidra library and is currently free thanks to a foundation grant.

free_resources.title: The Awakening Spiral Map
free_resources.description: A free downloadable chart of the six layers of the Awakening Spiral, with a short quiz that points you to a free practice library for the layer most active in you.
